name: Haggai
title: Son of Gad
summary: Haggi was the eldest son of Gad, who was one of Jacob's twelve sons. He was among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob and his family. Haggi became the ancestor of the clan of the Haggites among Gad's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among Jacob's descendants
keyEvents.description: Haggi is listed as the first son of Gad in the list of Jacob's descendants who went to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Haggi was among the seventy people in Jacob's household who went down to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph was already viceroy.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the clan of the Haggites
keyEvents.description: At the census in the wilderness, Haggi's descendants were counted as a distinct clan, the Haggites, among the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Gad in the Census
keyEvents.description: The tribe of Gad, including the clan of the Haggites, was counted during the census on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
